subject: Post-call: Scheduling rotating demo windows for NovaCorp (next steps)
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@novacorp.com>, Tom Li <tom.li@novacorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Scheduling rotating demo windows for NovaCorp (next steps)

Hi Alice / Tom —

Thanks for the productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to lock the demo/tech deep dive and a rotating schedule to cover US / EU / APAC stakeholders.

Recap (short)
- Primary use case: real-time inference for customer support triage (30-60 req/s, P95 latency target < 150ms)
- Data residency: EU data must stay in EU region
- Success criteria: demonstration of <200ms cold-start, autoscaling to 200 RPS, and prefix caching behavior
- Stakeholders: Alice Park (Product), Tom Li (Infra), Procurement will follow

Proposed next step
1) 60–75 minute technical deep dive (engineers + infra) — propose a rotating timeband pilot across 3 weeks so each regional team sees a convenient slot
2) Suggested rotation (week-by-week):
   - Week A (US-friendly): Tue 16:00–17:15 PT / Wed 00:00–01:15 UTC
   - Week B (EU-friendly): Thu 10:00–11:15 BST / Thu 05:00–06:15 PT
   - Week C (APAC-friendly): Mon 09:00–10:15 HKT / Sun 17:00–18:15 PT
3) If that looks ok, we'll schedule the first session on Week A (requested dates in Doodle below)

Attachments & links
- mutual_action_plan_novacorp.xlsx (attachment: MAP w/ milestones)
- Scheduling poll (Doodle): https://doodle.com/poll/xyz-novacorp-rotating
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/NB-2025-081

Next steps / asks
- Please confirm which week you prefer us to start (Week A/B/C) and any blackout dates
- Who should we invite from Infra for the tech deep dive? (Tom, plus one backend engineer)
- I'll send calendar holds once we agree.

Thanks — I'll loop CS and Solutions to prepare a focused demo.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0192
Attachments: mutual_action_plan_novacorp.xlsx

Thanks Sean — great recap.

Quick notes:
- EU morning slots work best for Product & Compliance (we prefer Week B start)
- Infra (Tom) is available Thu and Fri mornings BST; his senior backend will join (Jessica Ho <jessica.ho@novacorp.com>)
- Procurement looped for contract/PO timeline; they'll review the MAP and revert.

Can we compress the first tech session to 60 minutes and focus on live inference trace + KV caching behavior? If possible, please include a short pre-read (one-pager) for Product.

I filled out the Doodle with "Week B" preference and indicated blackout on Thu 2025-09-10 (leadership offsite). Thanks — Alice
